_comment: Operator attestation of npm trusted-publishing setup (audit Z5).
npm exposes no public API to query trusted-publisher configuration, so this
committed matrix is the machine-readable source of truth. After configuring a
package on npmjs.com (Package -> Settings -> Trusted Publisher -> GitHub Actions,
repository 'opendlt/infrix-sdk-js', workflow 'publish.yml'), set that package's
configured=true and fill in operator + date. `release-npm.mjs --publish
--require-trusted-publisher-ready` refuses to write to the registry until EVERY
publishable package here is configured=true, so a partial release caused by a
package that lacks trusted-publisher setup cannot happen. Keep this list in sync
with scripts/release-packages.mjs — the gate fails if any publishable package is
missing an entry.
Plan-3 (npm lane split): this trusted-publisher gate is the PUBLISH gate for the
npm-registry-published lane. After a real publish, scripts/verify-npm-registry.mjs
queries the LIVE registry and emits npm-registry-verification.json — that artifact
(allLive=true, 11/11) is the ONLY evidence that turns the infrix-core
npm-registry-published lane green. Buildability is the SEPARATE npm-pack-manifest
lane (supply-chain-all.mjs --manifest). configured=false = RED until the
operator registers the package on npmjs.com. STATUS 2026-07-23: all 11
configured=true — every package has a GitHub Actions trusted publisher
(opendlt/infrix-sdk-js, publish.yml), so publish.yml runs pure OIDC (no token).
